title: salvia pratensis var. agrestis
intro: Salvia pratensis var. agrestis, commonly known as Wild Meadow Sage, is a perennial plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its delicate purple flowers and tall stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote health benefits, including soothing digestive issues, relieving anxiety, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Wild Meadow Sage are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic agent, which helps to ease pain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which work together to provide its medicinal benefits.
